definitions.explanation: A type of small bamboo with broad leaves, used for wrapping food and in traditional decorations.

notes:
{笹|ささ} refers to sasa bamboo grass, smaller than regular bamboo.

Cultural note:
{笹|ささ} is central to ⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧ (Tanabata) celebrations, where wishes written on ⟦{短冊|たんざく}→短冊：13674_tanzaku⟧ (paper strips) are hung on bamboo grass branches. {笹|ささ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧ has antimicrobial properties and has been used to wrap food for centuries. Unlike regular bamboo (⟦{竹|たけ}→竹：02220_take⟧), {笹|ささ} stays small and has broader leaves.
